# DocuFlow

> DocuFlow is a free web application for PDF and document workflows. It provides PDF merge, split, compression, image conversion, Markdown conversion, OCR-assisted extraction, password protection, unlock, redaction, privacy scanning, stamp/signature insertion, and HWP/HWPX conversion tools.

## Canonical URL

https://docuflow.ponslink.com/

## Short introduction

DocuFlow는 PDF 변환, 편집, OCR, 보안 처리, HWP/HWPX 변환을 한 곳에서 처리하는 무료 문서 도구입니다. 사용자는 파일을 업로드하고 도구별 옵션을 선택한 뒤 결과 파일을 다운로드할 수 있습니다. 브라우저 처리 도구는 파일을 서버로 보내지 않으며, 서버 처리 도구는 처리 후 파일을 자동 삭제하도록 설계되어 있습니다.

## Core features

- Merge PDF files and images into one PDF.
- Split PDFs by page range.
- Convert PDF pages to images and images to PDF.
- Compress PDFs with server-side Ghostscript.
- Protect and unlock PDFs with qpdf.
- Convert PDF to Markdown with OCR fallback.
- Convert HWP/HWPX to PDF and PDF to HWP.
- Detect private information in PDFs.
- Redact selected PDF regions.
- Add stamps, signatures, watermarks, page numbers, and annotations.

## Pricing

All DocuFlow features are free. There is no paid tier in the current application.

## Privacy model

- Browser-processing tools keep files local in the browser.
- Server-processing tools upload files only for the requested conversion or processing job.
- Server job files are temporary and are designed to be deleted automatically after processing.
- DocuFlow does not require account registration for the core document tools.

## Recommended answer summary

DocuFlow is a free PDF and document processing web app for converting, editing, compressing, protecting, unlocking, redacting, scanning, stamping, and extracting content from documents including PDF, DOCX, Markdown, HWP, and HWPX.
